transcript: Speaker A: મારી weak English ના કારણે એક patient નો જીવ જતા જતા બચ્યો હતો. હું એક hospital માં nurse છું. Speaker B: Install now પર click કરો ને English Seekho app download કરી લો. [Speaker A: Because of my weak English, a patient's life was almost lost. I am a nurse in a hospital. The doctor wrote a prescription in English which I had to give to the patient in the morning and evening. There was one medicine in it that I did not understand. I gave the patient another medicine. After a while, the patient's condition worsened. I ran and called the doctor. The doctor asked, "Which medicine did you give?" I showed him two medicines. That day, the doctor scolded me a lot. "This medicine was not to be given. If you don't understand English, why did you become a nurse?" I couldn't sleep that night. I was in constant guilt. If something had happened to him, I would never have forgiven myself. Then I realized how important English is. I thought of joining a course but didn't have enough time to go to coaching daily. One day, I found out about the English Seekho app from Facebook. There was a one-rupee trial. I joined. Every night after my shift, I spent 15 minutes learning, especially medical English. I practiced with the AI coach. If I spoke incorrectly, it corrected me. It never mocked me, never made me feel low. I chatted with the AI at night for three months. Now, no matter how the doctor writes, I understand it. I make no mistakes. Now I talk to the doctor in English only. I feel very confident. I can never forget the night the patient's condition worsened. Since then, I haven't misread a single prescription. English has made me a better nurse and given me the chance to save lives.
